subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.**

He is a good soul. Although the ______ of his shoe is worn out, he never asks anyone to help him with money.
solution: The correct answer is **"sole."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Sole'** refers to the bottom part of a shoe (पैर का तलुवा). • **Example**:* The **sole**__ of her shoe was broken.* • Here, we are talking about shoe, so the correct word is **"sole."** • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *He is a good soul. Although the __**sole**__ of his shoe is worn out, he never asks anyone to help him with money.*​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • 'Soil' refers to the top layer of earth. (पृथ्वी की सबसे ऊपरी परत) • Example: *This is sandy soil__.* • 'Seal' refers to a device used to close or secure something. (किसी चीज़ को बंद करने या सुरक्षित करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला उपकरण) __ • Example: *She used the seal__ of her college.* • 'Sold' is the past tense of 'sell'. It means to give something to somebody who pays for it and is then the owner of it. (किसी को कुछ बेचना (दाम लेकर वस्‍तु देना, और ग्राहक का वस्‍तु का स्‍वामी हो जाना)) __ • Example: *She sold__ my car.* 30:Ta59, The correct answer is** "it has just been painted."**
